content_text:
Hi everyone! I’ve got a shoot coming up shooting out the side door of a chopper. Usually the camera is bungie cabled or on the shoulder but I’m wondering if anyone has any experience rigging a head and legs to be able to operate. My initial thoughts were to strap down a 2575 and pan and tilt. Is this something that can be done or is it just a vibration nightmare? looking for relatively solid shots. Any stories or tips would help!
thanks
Nick
